advancement.scope: intermediate waypoints only; applies identically to every controller
advancement.plane_crossing: advance after crossing the waypoint-normal plane in the direction of the next leg
advancement.rationale: three approximate vehicle lengths; independent of the unchanged 2 m final success radius

selection.prohibition: No evaluation seed or P3 result may influence gain selection. The grid and objective are frozen before held-out tuning.

controllers.frozen-untrained-policy-v1: retained fixed MLP; full route and corrected advancement supplied by harness
controllers.LOS-PID-v2: LOS heading reference with proportional speed and PD yaw inner loops
controllers.LOS-SPEEDCAP-v2: same LOS reference; receding target-speed law using stopping-distance and heading-error constraints, with PD yaw inner loop
